x: Surrey A.C. through a great run by Presland had come through from 15th to 3rd and Portsmouth 'B' team turning the tables on their 'A' team runner Frank Salvat were up to 6th with their 'A' team 9th.

[illegible]tage XI Chris Steer (21:03 - 14th fastest) Once again our hopes were raised only to be cruelly shattered when we found that Chris, on his first Brighton, was to pit his strength against Frank Salvat of Pompey.

Tony Fairclough had different ideas on the subject and caring little for the reputation of Frank Salvat,produced the best ever run by a Belgrave Harrier on this leg;and in knocking four seconds from Dave Baulch's club record became the first Belgravian to beat twenty minutes.
